mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/tls-verification.md <<'EOF'
# TLS certificate verification

TLS certificate verification is enabled in all builds, development builds included; this has been the project's recorded decision since 2026-09-25. Testing is done with self-signed certificates rather than by turning verification off.

cat docs/policies/tls-verification.md

I created `docs/policies/tls-verification.md`. It says TLS certificate verification is enabled in all builds, development builds included, and that testing uses self-signed certificates instead of turning verification off.

This comes from two recorded decisions from 2026-09-25: #30 (verification in all builds from now on) and #31 (self-signed certificates for testing). Decision #30 replaced an older record, #12, so the paragraph doesn't mention that earlier position. I didn't check the code against the policy.

My first attempt to write the file with a shell command failed, so I used the Write tool. The directory `docs/policies/` did not exist before.
